Rosa (CS): NovaHealth demo rehearsal failed due to rate limits. Need temporary QPS bump + allowlist for AP-SOUTH pilot. Renewal in ~5 weeks, flagged high risk if demo fails. Request: org_nova_19 qps 100->650, CIDR 203.0.115.0/24, start 2026-04-02T01:00Z, duration 36h, autorevoke 48h. Can netops/security greenlight? :eyes:

Evan (SE): Copy. What's traffic shape? bursts or sustained? Model sizes?

Rosa (CS): Chat completions, avg 220 tokens. Baseline steady ~100 RPS, rehearsal showed 600RPS bursts for ~15m. Traffic from ap-south-1 single egress block.

Noah (NetOps): I can add CIDR and temp policy. Need ticket + exact times and AM approval. Suggest canary at 200qps for 15m then ramp to 650.

Tara (Security): Prefer signed header (X-Nova-Sig) in addition to CIDR. If CIDR is unavoidable, limit to the /24 and add anomaly alerts.

Rosa (CS): Customer can provide HMAC header. I'll include it and AM notes in the ticket.

Noah (NetOps): INC-5620 opened: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-5620 — NovaHealth AP-SOUTH temp QPS bump + CIDR allowlist. ETA apply ~25m.

ops-bot: Policy queued: org=org_nova_19 qps=650 duration=36h autorevoke=48h allowlist=[203.0.115.0/24] region=ap-south-1 notes=[HMAC recommended]

Noah (NetOps): Rules applied to ap-south edge. INC-5620 updated. Canary live at 200qps.

Evan (SE): Canary healthy after 12m. p95 latency 0.5s, 5xx=0. Promoting to demo cap 650 qps.

Rosa (CS): Great — demo scheduled. AM looped for renewal check. Will monitor and report post-demo. :thumbsup:
